details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (headline financial performance), K2 (segment performance), K3 (warehouse commissioning), K4 (retail expansion), K5 (own brand development), and K6 (liquidity position). However, it omits the core material meaning of K7 (brand awareness metrics), K8 (strategic focus areas), and K9 (material post-reporting events). The summary captures most of the high-importance material information but lacks several key strategic and post-reporting elements, resulting in a 'Generally yes' rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The narrative progresses from overall performance to specific drivers, financial metrics, strategic investments, and concludes with cash flow and capital structure implications. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetitions. All figures and their relationships are presented consistently without implying arithmetic contradictions. The structure moves logically from revenue growth to profitability, strategic initiatives, and financial position, forming a coherent whole.
